description: A compressor that turns into a waveshaper: it follows the envelope of the input and divides the signal down by however far that envelope has passed a threshold.

params.text: Sets the voltage the envelope has to pass before the signal is pushed down, 0V to 10V.
Sets how fast the envelope follower moves, 0 to 1; at the top it follows each cycle of the waveform and the reduction becomes harmonic distortion.

inputs.text: Adds to the grit knob, one unit of its travel per volt, the two together held between 0 and 1.

outputs.text: The input divided by one plus the amount the envelope has passed the threshold, as a fraction of the threshold.

notes: The module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and one channel comes out.
The red lamp beside the output is never lit. The code that drove it is commented out, so it says nothing about how hard the module is working.

inputs.0:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
